The measurement blends prior_K = w*mean(Steamer, ZiPS) with a pitch-shape whiff grade (w 0.5, or 0.3 after an arsenal change of a new pitch >=10% or velocity >=1.5 mph), shrinks the posterior with k=150 BF, down-weights pre-change BF to 0.25, and uses MiLB-translated projections for rookies under 100 BF.
